train_one_epoch: train an OpenCLIP model for one epoch using images, texts, optimizer, and scheduler
train_one_epoch_w_mask: train an OpenCLIP model for one epoch with image masks using optimizer and scheduler
evaluate: evaluate an OpenCLIP model on validation data and compute zero-shot and retrieval metrics
get_metrics: compute image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval metrics including mean rank and recall at k
AverageMeter: create an AverageMeter to track running average and current values for training metrics
